transcript.text: Good morning. I'd like to get ahead of the Friday roster review. We need to staff the Saturday dispatch desk and the Sunday communications-log desk, both 0800 to 1200, from the pool of SPC Jordan, PFC Malik, and SPC Chen. Before I publish the final roster, I need the motor transport NCO to confirm dispatch desk qualifications and the signal NCO to confirm communications-log qualifications for these three personnel, along with any control entries that need to be noted. Can we start with those qualification checks?
